data.one_liner: AWS S3 storage plugin for Flutter via Amplify
data.what_it_does: Provides upload, download, list, remove, and getUrl operations for Amazon S3. It returns operation objects for advanced control and integrates with Amplify's Storage category.
use_when: You need to store files in Amazon S3 from a Flutter app
You already use Amplify for other services and want a unified SDK
You require multi‑bucket support or wasm support for web
avoid_when: You need local or device‑only storage
You prefer a lightweight HTTP client for simple uploads
You are building a non‑AWS backend
strengths: Operation objects allow cancellation and pause
Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux)
weaknesses: Requires Amplify configuration and backend setup
Not suitable for local storage needs
data.setup_notes: Add amplify_core and amplify_storage_s3 to pubspec, run Amplify.addPlugin, configure Amplify in main, ensure AWS credentials and S3 bucket are set up in Amplify console.
